evidence.text: Leevi Meriläinen leads the #Canucks into the ice Saturday in Newark. He’ll get the start @ Devils.
Joonas Korpisalo (lower body) is out 4 weeks from today.
Joe Veleno (lower body) is out 3-3.5 months.
Igor Shesterkin will be out for the rest of the season with his lower body injury.
Carbery said it’s too early to tell whether Pierre-Luc Dubois will suit up tomorrow.
Matt Roy skated again today and remains day-to-day.
